notes: Single-stage: parse a two-format HTTP access log (strict validation, near-miss malformed lines) and compute a battery of derived statistics over the parsed records: status-class counts, error rate percentage, mean latency, interpolated p95, byte totals, unique-client cardinality, per-endpoint aggregates, and a threshold-derived health verdict. Hard floor: strict dual-format parsing plus a precisely specified interpolation percentile and derived-threshold field. Rubric nonzero for reasoning_depth (two formats + percentile interpolation), debugging_ambiguity (near-miss lines), adversarial_inputs/hidden_case_generalization (five hidden cases incl. empty/all-malformed/single), quantitative_correctness (exact floats and derived aggregates).
